content.subtitle: A case for public private partnership
content.summary: A research seminar on 'Learning from Institutional Partnership: A case for public private partnership' was held from June 4-5, 2010 at Baragali, Peshawer.

media.alt: A research seminar on "Learning from Institutional Partnership"

content.text: A research seminar on 'Learning from Institutional Partnership: A case for public private partnership' was held from June 4-5, 2010 at Baragali, Peshawer. The seminar was a part of the three-year 'Pak-Norway Institutional Cooperation Project' partnered by AKU-IED, Oslo University College and Institute of Educational Research , Peshawer University.

The two-day research seminar provided an opportunity to disseminate findings of joint research studies conducted as part of the project. It also enabled the partnering institutions to share lessons learnt from the unique public private partnership. A number of faculty members of the partnering institutions presented papers which generated a lot of discussion. The seminar was attended by academics, managers, researchers, and practitioners from the field of education and teacher education.

The participants felt that such forums for dissemination of best practices should be facilitated regularly and the deliberations from the seminar will help in improving the quality of education in Pakistan in general and in Khyber Pukhtunkhwa in particular. The seminar was a concluding activity of the project.
